candidates.name: auth_recovery_obs
candidates.hypothesis: When API tools return 401 Unauthorized / missing access token errors, agents frequently waste 15-20 turns reverse-engineering SDK internals and session state, leading to step budget timeouts. Augmenting 401 observation returns in tool_policy with explicit guidance to pass access_token directly and re-authenticate if expired will eliminate wasted turns and recover failed tasks.
candidates.changes: In variants/tool_policy/default.py, format_observation appends actionable authentication guidance whenever a tool response contains a 401 Unauthorized / access token error.
candidates.expected_efficiency: Saves 10-20 turns per task on tasks requiring authenticated API endpoints, increasing pass rate from 96.7% towards 100% and reducing overall token usage.
